newsitem.title: USA: Group raises stake in Oshkosh B'Gosh.
newsitem.headline: Group raises stake in Oshkosh B'Gosh.

text.p: A group led by Stinson Capital Partners L.P. said Friday it raised its stake in Oshkosh B'Gosh Inc to 934,700 Class A common shares or 8.4 percent of the outstanding from 7.4 percent held on July 3.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 110,000 additional shares between July 2 and July 24 at prices ranging from $16 to $18.125 per share. Oshkosh has 11,189,171 common shares outstanding.
The group said it bought the shares for investment purposes.
